name: indie-payment-kit
description: One entry point to choose, integrate, and verify payment providers for indie products.

interface.shortDescription: Choose and verify the right payment stack
interface.longDescription: Scan an indie SaaS, API, or digital-product project, compare eight common global and China payment providers, route to current official provider skills and documentation, and apply a provider-neutral checkout, webhook, entitlement, refund, and go-live contract.
defaultPrompt: Use $indie-payment-kit to choose the right payment provider for this project.
Use $indie-payment-kit to review this payment integration before launch.
Use $indie-payment-kit to plan a safe migration to another payment provider.
